panels.description: Active sampler links in each selected trace group. Zero or No data means sampling is not active.

targets.expr: max by (group) (banyandb_trace_pipeline_sampler_active_count{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group"})

panels.title: Active Samplers

panels.description: Dropped traces divided by successfully evaluated traces across the selected dashboard range. Interpret against the configured sampling policy.

targets.expr: sum by (group) (increase(banyandb_trace_tst_pipeline_traces_dropped{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum by (group) (increase(banyandb_trace_tst_pipeline_traces_evaluated{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group"}[$__range])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Effective Drop Ratio

panels.description: Plugin load failures in the selected dashboard range. The pipeline fails open, so any value is actionable.

targets.expr: (sum by (group, name, reason) (increase(banyandb_trace_pipeline_sampler_load_failed{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Plugin Load Failures

panels.description: Merges in the selected dashboard range that exhausted the bounded drop-ID set. Requested drops are retained.

targets.expr: (sum by (group, lane) (increase(banyandb_trace_tst_pipeline_merges_ceiling_reached{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Capped Merges

panels.description: Calls to each plugin link, split by result. Non-success paths retain affected input.

targets.expr: sum by (group, plugin_name, result) (rate(banyandb_trace_tst_pipeline_plugin_executions{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group", plugin_name=~"$plugin"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Execution Rate by Result

panels.description: Primary per-plugin cost signal. Compare each plugin with its own healthy baseline; no universal threshold is safe.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (group, plugin_name, le) (rate(banyandb_trace_tst_pipeline_plugin_execution_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group", plugin_name=~"$plugin", result="success"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Successful Decide Latency p99

panels.description: Plugin-chain batches split into success, timeout, and circuit-open outcomes.

targets.expr: sum by (group, result) (rate(banyandb_trace_tst_pipeline_plugin_batches{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Chain Batch Rate by Result

panels.description: Successful plugin wall time normalized by evaluated trace count, so batch-shape changes are visible.

targets.expr: sum by (group, plugin_name) (rate(banyandb_trace_tst_pipeline_plugin_execution_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group", plugin_name=~"$plugin", result="success"}[$__rate_interval])) / on (group) group_left sum by (group) (rate(banyandb_trace_tst_pipeline_traces_evaluated{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Plugin Time per Evaluated Trace

panels.description: p99 traces per successful chain decision batch; use it to explain execution-cost changes.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (group, le) (rate(banyandb_trace_tst_pipeline_plugin_batch_traces_bucket{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group", result="success"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Successful Decision Batch Size p99

panels.description: Retained includes plugin keep verdicts and safety/fail-open retention, so it need not equal evaluated minus dropped.

targets.expr: sum by (group) (rate(banyandb_trace_tst_pipeline_traces_evaluated{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (group) (rate(banyandb_trace_tst_pipeline_traces_retained{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (group) (rate(banyandb_trace_tst_pipeline_traces_dropped{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (group) (rate(banyandb_trace_tst_pipeline_traces_immature{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Trace Outcomes

panels.description: Fail-open and bounded-retention paths that can reduce the effective drop ratio independently of plugin policy.

targets.expr: sum by (group) (rate(banyandb_trace_tst_pipeline_oversized_traces_bypassed{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (group) (rate(banyandb_trace_tst_pipeline_ambiguous{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (group) (rate(banyandb_trace_tst_pipeline_guard_deferred{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (group) (rate(banyandb_trace_tst_pipeline_guard_budget_exhausted{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (group) (rate(banyandb_trace_tst_pipeline_guard_publication_rejected{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (group) (rate(banyandb_trace_tst_pipeline_guard_lossless_retry{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (group) (rate(banyandb_trace_tst_pipeline_guard_bypassed{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (group, reason) (rate(banyandb_trace_tst_pipeline_plugin_errors{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Safety Events

panels.description: First-party sampler decisions and evaluated rows by the first matching fixed rule slot. Proposed drops are not committed storage deletions.

targets.expr: sum by (group, plugin_name, verdict, rule) (rate(banyandb_trace_pipeline_plugin_trace_sampler_decisions_total{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (group, plugin_name, rule) (rate(banyandb_trace_pipeline_plugin_trace_sampler_rows_dropped_total{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (group, plugin_name) (rate(banyandb_trace_pipeline_plugin_trace_sampler_rows_total{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Sampler Decisions & Rows by Rule

panels.description: Capped merges and traces retained by the cap are different event types but together show cap frequency and effect.

targets.expr: sum by (group, lane) (rate(banyandb_trace_tst_pipeline_merges_ceiling_reached{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (group) (rate(banyandb_trace_tst_pipeline_traces_retained_by_ceiling{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Drop-set Cap Impact

panels.description: p99 count of dropped trace IDs held per merge. It cannot be divided by the byte budget to infer utilization.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (group, lane, le) (rate(banyandb_trace_tst_pipeline_drop_set_entries_bucket{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Dropped-ID Set Size p99

panels.description: Resolved per-merge memory budget for confirmed dropped trace IDs; this is capacity, not current usage.

targets.expr: max by (group) (banyandb_trace_tst_pipeline_drop_set_budget_bytes{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group"})

panels.title: Drop-set Budget

panels.description: Highest cooled-shard round and terminal state per group. Terminal=1 means another finalization round cannot run.

targets.expr: max by (group) (banyandb_trace_pipeline_finalize_rounds{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group"})
max by (group) (banyandb_trace_pipeline_finalize_terminal{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group"})

panels.title: Finalization State

panels.description: Host-enforced telemetry limits. No data is valid for plugins that do not publish HostAware telemetry.

targets.expr: sum by (group, plugin_name) (rate(banyandb_trace_pipeline_plugin_telemetry_series_rejected_total{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group", plugin_name=~"$plugin"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (group, plugin_name) (rate(banyandb_trace_pipeline_plugin_log_dropped_total{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group", plugin_name=~"$plugin"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (group, plugin_name) (rate(banyandb_trace_pipeline_plugin_telemetry_panic_total{job=~"$job", container_name=~"$role", pod_name=~"$pod", group=~"$group", plugin_name=~"$plugin"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Plugin Telemetry Host Safety
